summary: Frontend testing of Meelora V2 cross-cutting UX slice (Company Home, header cleanup, avatar menu reorg, password self-service change, 4-language DE/IT-disabled card, Client fiche country→region→tax proposal, invoice OANDA disabled placeholder). All 9 request checkpoints pass on persona_finance@accslegro.com. Password credentials were reverted back to 'persona123' in the same session.

issues: React hydration warning: <span> cannot be a child of <option>. The visual editor injects a <span> inside <option> elements produced by the periods.map(). Not user-visible but pollutes console. Consider stripping x-source annotations from <option> children or rendering plain text.

detailed_results.1_login_landing: PASS — persona_finance lands directly on data-testid=company-home. Header shows breadcrumb 'MANDAT › ACCUEIL'. No data-testid=company-selector in header (correctly removed).
detailed_results.2_company_home_content: PASS — 'Bienvenue chez meelora' + identity line (25 avenue Dumas · Genève, Genève · 1206 · CA) + KPIs (kpi-revenue-month 3 500,00 CHF, kpi-revenue-ytd 4 800,00 CHF, kpi-open-invoices 3 (2 918,70 CHF), kpi-collections-month 1 081,00 CHF).
detailed_results.3_sidebar_navigation: PASS — Sidebar 'MANDAT ACTIF meelora' switcher visible. Comptabilité popover opens; clicking 'Ventes & Clients' navigates to data-testid=ar-page. No regression.
detailed_results.4_avatar_menu: PASS — menu-profile, menu-language (with 4 lang-option-*, DE+IT disabled, EN+FR enabled), logout-btn all present. menu-security is NOT present (correctly removed).
detailed_results.5_mon_profil_cards: PASS — preferences-page + password-card + lang-card visible. lang-de-btn & lang-it-btn are disabled; lang-en-btn & lang-fr-btn enabled.
detailed_results.6_password_change_flow: PASS — Wrong current → toast 'Mot de passe actuel incorrect'. Mismatch → 'Les mots de passe ne correspondent pas'. Weak → 'Au moins 8 caractères, avec une lettre et un chiffre'. Successful change persona123 → persona999a → success toast 'Mot de passe mis à jour'. Immediately reverted persona999a → persona123 → success toast. Fresh login with persona123 works (confirmed on next session). Session stayed logged in throughout, no crash.
detailed_results.7_tax_proposal: PASS — cust-country=CA + cust-region=QC → cust-tax-proposal panel with cust-tax-pick-GST_QST. Switching to CH → panel refreshes with VAT codes (VAT taux normal 8.100%, VAT taux réduit 2.600%). Confirms central tax engine consumption.
detailed_results.8_customer_creation: PASS — Created TEST customer with CA+QC. Row appears with data-testid=cust-row-<id> (note: request spec says 'cust-row' but actual pattern is 'cust-row-{id}'). Expanded row shows Juridiction: CA-QC/QC, Conditions: NET30 (30 j), Taxe défaut: GST_QST, Réf/PO row present.
detailed_results.9_invoice_oanda_placeholder: PASS — Factures → 'Nouvelle facture' → data-testid=inv-fetch-rate present, disabled, labeled 'Récupérer le taux'.
detailed_results.10_console: 9-13 console errors (mostly 403/404 on unrelated resource endpoints for features not accessible to persona_finance, plus one React hydration warning about <span> inside <option>). None block functionality.

action_items: Optional/low priority: fix React hydration warning caused by visual-editor <span> being injected inside <option> in SalesAR InvoicesTab period select (line ~513). Rendering `{p.code}` without wrapping annotation would silence the console noise.

Documentation nit: the review request references data-testid=cust-row but the actual attribute is cust-row-{id}. Adjust either the docs or add a parent cust-row wrapper — no code change strictly needed.
critical_code_review_comments: Layout.js is heavy (>700 lines suspected based on Layout line 749 references). Consider splitting header/sidebar/main scaffolding into subcomponents.
Multiple 403/404 network errors on Company Home suggest the frontend fetches endpoints not scoped to the user role. Consider gating requests by capability to avoid noisy consoles.
